name: What is the process for starting a mobility improvement remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a mobility improvement remodel with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your needs, challenges, and vision for your home. This is followed by an on-site assessment to evaluate the current space and identify feasible modifications. We then develop a detailed proposal, including design concepts, material selections, and a transparent cost estimate. Once approved, our team handles all aspects of permitting and construction, keeping you informed throughout the project until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation, followed by an on-site assessment, detailed proposal, and then full project management from permitting to construction completion.
